instruction.text: ANTON United played in a football tournament over the weekend. The number of goals each child scored is recorded in the table below. Answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How many goals did Rachel score?

atoms.b: ((Tony ++Kim Rachel Gregory Vitan)) scored the most goals.

atoms.a: How many goals did Vitan score?
Who scored the same amount of goals?
atoms.b: ((++Tony Kim Rachel Gregory ++Vitan)) and ((++Tony Kim Rachel Gregory ++Vitan)) scored the same amount of goals.

atoms.a: The goalkeeper scored the least amount of goals. Who was the goalkeeper?
atoms.b: ((Tony Kim Rachel ++Gregory Vitan)) was the goalkeeper.

instruction.text: The airline Good Times Airways flies four times a day from London to Berlin. Answer the following questions.

atoms.a: When does the last flight to Berlin depart from London?
atoms.b: The last flight leaves London at ((21 9)):((10)).

atoms.a: Which flight is scheduled to land in Berlin at 13:58?
atoms.b: Flight ((A ++B C D)) is scheduled to land at 13:58.

atoms.a: Take-off for flight A is delayed by 2 hours. When will flight A depart from London?
atoms.sound: Take-off for flight Ay is delayed by 2 hours. When will flight Ay depart from London?
atoms.b: Flight A will depart from London at ((11)):((30)).

atoms.a: Due to the delayed take-off, flight A will land 2 hours later than scheduled. When will flight A reach Berlin?
atoms.sound: Due to the delayed take-off, flight Ay will land 2 hours later than scheduled. When will flight Ay reach Berlin?
atoms.b: Flight A will land in Berlin at ((13 1)):((25)).

atoms.a: Which flight is scheduled for boarding at 16:20?
atoms.b: Flight ((A B ++C D)) is scheduled for boarding at 16:20.
